## 1. Prediction market

The [presidential market](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) held **Lula at 49.50% (USD 6.43M)** on June 14, at the cycle peak, with the gap over **Flávio Bolsonaro, at 26.65% (USD 6.60M)**, at +22.85pp, near the widest ever measured. The day's movement, however, came from the third name: **Renan Santos rose to 14.65% (USD 6.98M)**, up ↑1.55pp and the largest of the day in the winner's market, sustained by the highest accumulated volume among candidates. The **total accumulated volume in the presidential market totals approximately USD 99.6M**, reinforcing the thesis of real money behind the quotations.

The reading that organizes the frame follows the "right's paradox" described by [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest)'s director: Flávio loses strength, but rivals do not convert that loss into declared votes in polls, according to [Quaest's coverage by G1](https://news.google.?oc=5). For this reason, Renan's rise in the market coexists with only 3% in the latest national poll, the Genial/[Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of June 10, widening the panel's largest divergence, detailed in Section 4.

In the third way, the [presidential market](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) had only repositioning at the floor. **Zema rose to 1.95% (USD 3.65M)**, up ↑0.30pp, **Haddad to 2.05% (USD 5.72M)**, ↑0.05pp, and **Caiado remained stable at 1.35% (USD 4.02M)**. **Camilo Santana, at 2.45%**, continues as the fourth presidential name in the market, ahead of Haddad.

In the institutional market, the [STF justice impeachment](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) contract remained **stable at 3.60% (USD 82k)**, a low level with little liquidity, with no risk repricing over the weekend. In the [2026 annual inflation](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026) market, the bands from 5.00% to 5.49% (25.65%) and 5.50% to 5.99% (25.35%) lead nearly tied, a distribution indicating persistent uncertainty, with slight relief on the high tail compared to the eve.

The sub-markets for [second](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place) and [third place](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place) in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) were **lightly traded** in today's survey, with fine quotations for the main names, a signal calling for caution and which, for now, does not support reliable reading of favoritism in those positions.

## 2. What the institutes registered

The national benchmark of the period continues to be the **Genial/[Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of June 10** (n=2.004, field from June 5 to 8, margin of 2pp): [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with Lula at 39% versus 29% for Flávio (gap +10pp) and [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) at 44% versus 38% (gap +6pp), with Lula winning all scenarios and government approval at 47% versus 48% disapproval. There was no new national poll published on June 14, and the press is already working with expectations of a new [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) next week, with numbers not yet disclosed ([VEJA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxOM0NYVEFEdm1nUHN2YWMxQlY4c1c2cXpRSDJrMVBERUN6Z3B5NXR5ME9vSlZ1WUdWYnJLQ1Z2cjREZmg2SDA3VExMLUktZGlGTnhGZkVJaG9oT2tpQUZWYUFzbUpJdnFBalo5Um5kWThZT2h4U0pjRzA4dTQ2Y3ZYMUppUDdxYUVXVm1hNnhkWkZVZThzOVppc0NjdEZwUWw2MGE2LVE0SEVyTjhkWmpTdk5HVEVVeS1PSkE?oc=5)).

Unlike previous weeks, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration window for the next seven days now contains **national-scope surveys**, not just state-level ones: registered for disclosure are [Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) (June 15), MDA, American Analytics and 100 Cidades (June 16) and [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) (June 19), all with declared national universe and samples from 1,000 respondents. The complete calendar is in the block below.

## 3. What the press covered

On the government side, the day's agenda was international: Lula departed for the **G7 meeting in France**, with no formal bilateral meeting with Donald Trump confirmed on the schedule, according to [weekend news coverage](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQUTY1Z3M1R1VMOVRMUGp2RllHOFBlUk96ZldzNGNYUXhZUXVZdUY2cGFhUU5Yb0REUEo0MWlud083dkhpcUFFSEhmSWlaNENBQUxLNFZZeW5JVE5UMFlvRVpFY2J3XzEtaXJDeGRpUEtZalJ0bmZIcWptX2lzZ1NocnN6c3Yxdw?oc=5). In Congress, the processing of the [PEC](/en/glossary#pec) to end the 6x1 work schedule continues in the Senate following approval in the Chamber, with government coordination stalled by lack of dialogue with Senate president Davi Alcolumbre, who is advancing his own agenda ([G1](https://news.google.?oc=5)).

On the opposition side, the week solidified the reading of wear-and-tear on Flávio. [Genial/Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) registered **loss of support among evangelicals, women, youth and in the Southeast**, as reported by [G1](https://news.google.?oc=5) and by [Quaest regional coverage](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNa2lXaHA2aHFRbGhVSTNtc3JHeGhHTDlmeW9ITVdzTVh5NjZraHFrRXQzNWN0SVRjREFQX09GOFVXV2dzYVQ3X3hkNlBZbEVlanBfQS1xWGNhUUljdklPa010NWw4NDRyeFBna2NwbjZGT2NTLWl3a3JDellHa0lZOXlyQU9DbWtNSjREcVk1aHBZMnVvMTB5RFVHU2MxUmoxc3c?oc=5). The campaign still faces an impasse over the name of the running mate, and allies suggest testing Cleitinho ([Folha de S.Paulo via news aggregator](https://news.google.?oc=5)).

Right-wing internal friction gained a new chapter: **Eduardo Bolsonaro defended a break between the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) and [Novo](/en/glossary#novo)** following new remarks by Romeu Zema about Flávio and the Vorcaro case, according to [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/06/13/eduardo-bolsonaro-defende-rompimento-com-o-novo-apos-criticas-de-zema-a-flavio-bolsonaro.ghtml) and [aggregated coverage](https://news.google.?oc=5). In parallel, the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) decided that it will only **officially formalize Flávio's candidacy at the end of July, in an event in São Paulo** ([Gazeta do Povo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxNYzBJUHVYWDJKTGlsdXR1ZmNjanM5T1BzbXB0OWFvVkJ3N0JrbWZWSmNsRllKQ3BpOVR1SC1CRUJSSDF5bEZfTWJBWjBwbDNoSnljTU1Uc2cwQTFORXYwQXdfdGg0TXB2VFJIVGVWQ1VNQVlMajBNdnktX3pOS1pmVDRGdkdCemRtM0xSbG1nTVcyRTRVdnIzQXNRUDlNbm5CRUpFZVlUVGpYN2w1enUxUWNxcURBOHl2Y3Y3RkRiMmI3VHZYc3RKX0pn?oc=5)), which prolongs uncertainty in the field. On the institutional front, the Master case remained active with no new judicial action over the weekend, and the weekend was further emptied by the start of the World Cup, with Brazil playing Morocco dividing political attention.

## 4. Day's divergences

> **Market × survey:** Renan Santos rose to 14.65% in the winner market (↑1.55pp), but the latest national survey, the Genial/[Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of June 10, measures only 3% in the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). The difference, of roughly 11.65pp, is the largest on the panel and widened today. The market prices future conversion of digital capital into votes; the survey does not yet see traction.

> **Market × narrative:** the news coverage speaks of Renan's rise citing a new [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha), but the numbers from that survey were not released, and the most-shared headline about the name on the day dealt with a guess for the national team's match, not voting intention. The solid signal is the market movement, not a new electoral measurement.

> **Survey × market:** [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) shows Flávio losing support among relevant segments (evangelicals, women, youth), but the market kept him practically stable at 26.65% (↑0.10pp). The gap to Lula remained near the cycle record due to the president's firmness, not a new drop by Flávio.

## In summary

1. The market kept Lula at the cycle peak (49.50%, gap +22.85pp) and had as today's movement the rise of Renan to 14.65% (↑1.55pp), the largest gain among candidates.
2. The [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of June 10 remains the national reference, with Flávio losing support among evangelicals, women, and youth, while the opposition exposes friction with the defense of a rupture between [PL](/en/glossary#pl) and [Novo](/en/glossary#novo) by Eduardo Bolsonaro.
3. The largest divergence on the panel widened: Renan at 14.65% in the market against 3% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), roughly 11.65pp, without support in national survey.—
